summary: Intake readiness is still blocked for Registration. Evidence reviewed: `.ai_factory/delivery/intakes/13612888-96ef-4fa4-a304-4a400d9f2e24.md` requests Google/GitHub registration for module `feedback`; `.ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md` confirms Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright but leaves module constraints unspecified; `.ai_factory/delivery/planning` is missing. Prisma was added only partially: `package.json` includes `prisma` as a devDependency and `prisma.config.ts` exists, but there is no `prisma/` directory, no `schema.prisma`, no `@prisma/client`, and no customer/user/account model. `.env.local` contains OAuth variables, but PostgreSQL variables including `DATABASE_URL` are commented out, and no auth/session secret such as `AUTH_SECRET` or `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` was found. Search found no existing Auth.js/NextAuth provider wiring or registration architecture. No tests were run for this readiness review.

defects.description: Human clarification says Prisma was initialized, but the workspace has no `prisma/` directory, no `schema.prisma`, no generated/client dependency `@prisma/client`, and no customer identity data model. PostgreSQL connection values in `.env.local` are commented out, so delivery cannot safely design or validate customer record creation.

The intake requires Google and GitHub registration, but the repository has no selected auth library or documented auth/session strategy, callback route contract, redirect behavior, duplicate-account linking rule, or required auth secret variable.

No iteration plan exists under `.ai_factory/delivery/planning/`, and requirements/design/security/operations documentation for OAuth registration and persisted customer identities is missing, leaving acceptance expectations incomplete.
